_comment: WHICH GAME BUILD THESE TABLES DESCRIBE.
PRACTICES.md section 6: action ids move when the game is patched, and
the failure is silent -- a shifted id produces plausible wrong numbers
rather than an error. A name table captured against one build and read
against another is exactly that failure, so the build has to be
recorded for a mismatch to be detectable at all.
SF6WTT records the game version beside every id in its combo format for
HOW game_version WAS ESTABLISHED, and what is inference in it: the
tables were captured 2026-08-15 (file dates and the commit that added
them agree). StreetFighter6.exe reports FileVersion 1.0.0.33 and has
been unmodified since 2026-08-03, so that is the build that was
installed on the capture date. The command_display catalogs were
generated 2026-08-03 independently and carry their own hashes, which
corroborates the date but is not a second reading of the version.
The inference is 'the installed build did not change between 2026-08-03
and 2026-08-15'. Anything captured from here on should read the version
at capture time rather than reconstruct it.
game_version_confidence: inferred: the build installed on the capture date, not read at capture time
